clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh's cold heights, Cask of Shimmer Stout is bound for the eastern mountains. Rejold Barleybrew brewed the potent new ale, and his brother sends a cask east as a gift for fellow dwarven mountaineers.

Rejold Barleybrew brews Shimmer Stout in Brewnall Village, where local patrons and mountaineers who brave Dun Morogh's biting frosts take to it quickly. Impressed by his brother's brew, Mountaineer Barleybrew commissions a cask to be hauled through the eastern pass into Loch Modan. Dwarves prize strong drink for company and for warmth in the mountain chill. Sharing a fresh brew with comrades on distant patrols is a military tradition.

During his watch in Thelsamar, Mountaineer Kadrell opens the cask and samples the brew. Shimmer Stout lives up to its reputation: one draught is said to lighten the limbs and make a soldier feel as though he could fly. It is the sort of invigorating drink a dwarven scout might welcome on a long, lonely patrol along the high roads.
